name: Patient Responsibility — Deductible (Low Appeal Potential)
description: Deductible amount — patient responsibility. NOT typically appealable. Tests that the system correctly identifies non-appealable denials.

denial.denialLetterText:
WellCare
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: May 10, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 99213 (Office visit, established patient, level 3)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: PR1 — Deductible amount

PAYER STATEMENT: Patient responsibility: deductible amount applies. This is not a denial of medical necessity but a cost-sharing requirement under the benefit plan.

PROCEDURE: 99213 — Office visit, established patient, level 3
DIAGNOSIS: I10 — Essential (primary) hypertension

APPEAL RIGHTS: Cost-sharing amounts are generally not subject to appeal unless the deductible was applied in error.

APPEAL DEADLINE: September 7, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
WellCare

keyFactors: Only appealable if applied in error
System should correctly identify as non-appealable
